sources.title: qwen3.7-plus Model Info
sources.evidence: Exact alias maps to qwen3.7-plus-2026-05-26; documents 1,000,000 context tokens, text/image/video input, text output, function calling and thinking limits. Updated October 11, 2026. No model parameter counts, dense/MoE specification, weight-release classification or weight license stated.

sources.title: Model lifecycle and updates
sources.evidence: Release tables explicitly date qwen3.7-plus and its May 26 snapshot to June 1, 2026 in Singapore, Beijing and multiple global regions. Distinguishes subsequent US-specific rollout. Updated October 22, 2026.

sources.title: Qwen3.7-Plus: Multimodal Agent Intelligence
sources.evidence: Official June 3 announcement mirror identifies Plus as the Qwen3.7 vision-language agent model, supporting coding, tool use, images/video and extended thinking. Does not disclose total/active parameter counts or dense/MoE architecture, and does not explicitly classify Plus weights as proprietary.

open_weights.note: The exact model card maps Plus to its May 26 API snapshot. Neither the developer Qwen3.7 inventory nor the exact Plus search contains released weights. Classified closed under the public-download availability rule at review time; an explicit proprietary declaration is not required.

license.note: No exact-model weight license identified in the accessed primary documentation.

parameters_b.note: Nominal 397B language-model size explicitly reported in the Qwen3.7-Plus comparison column. Complete hosted tensor accounting is not supplied; use language_model scope.

active_parameters_b.note: Explicit nominal active count in the exact-model column of the first-party Language comparison table. Scoped to language_model; not a measured vision/MTP-inclusive execution count.

architecture.note: Vision-language capability does not establish dense versus MoE or an internal attention design.

context_window.note: Explicit context window in tokens, distinct from the smaller maximum input length.

reasoning.note: Hybrid thinking supported and enabled by default.

description.value: Qwen3.7 multimodal model with a 1M-token context, text, image and video inputs, thinking mode, and function calling for coding and agent workflows.
description.note: Replaces workhorse phrasing with documented capabilities; no benchmark superiority claim.

patch.description: Qwen3.7 multimodal model with a 1M-token context, text, image and video inputs, thinking mode, and function calling for coding and agent workflows.
patch.notes: The alias maps to qwen3.7-plus-2026-05-26; June 1 is the documented public release. The later official Flash-Next Language comparison table explicitly reports 397B parameters and 17B active for Qwen3.7-Plus. These are nominal language-model counts; complete hosted components are not quantified. Internal architecture and weight license remain unverified. No public Plus weight release is available. Classified as closed weights: no public release of this hosted variant was found in the developer documentation and weight inventory.
